purpose: Chemistry as evidence-based study of substances, structures, reactions, measurement, mechanisms, and real-world applications.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Name substance, conditions, units, analytical method, uncertainty, and exposure context. Distinguish measured products from proposed mechanisms and avoid procedural hazard instructions.
